soundness_flags.label: Proposition (prop:boundary-reductions), empty-margin reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: When T_0 is empty, margin extension is unavailable but population storage can still be admissible under its selection-independence predicate, so the claimed reduction to exactly the selected-source closure is false.
